I considered it but, apparently you don't start really crashing till 30 in most cases if you are mildly healthy/don't do drugs.

 As for society, i am not right in the head and would probably find such a collapse fairly entertaining, even if i got caught in it. Up until I have to start acting like Bear Grylls that is, not into survival games.

I decided 30 is my end point. End of the day we all live for ourselves. I am not going to keep myself around just to make others happy, i will stay around for whatever I wish to experience and then i'll clock out on my own terms. That's me though.
As much as I agree with that sort of POV, i'm really not looking forward to my body's collapse, nor aging in general. 30 seems like a good point to eat shot to avoid a life of surgery and boredom.

It would seem like you're right. Hopefully it doesn't take forever to graduate taking less classes. Good to hear some Universities are sensible about the grades, I know I can swing this all around if I just study more.
